newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cityhold unit in talks to buy competitor.
newsitem.headline: Cityhold unit in talks to buy competitor.

text.p: City Investment Holdings Ltd (Cityhold) said on Monday its Plumbware division was in talks to take over a competitor which if succesful could lead to an increased market share.

Cityhold said at the release of its second interim results, after changing the year-end from September to December, that its gearing was within acceptable levels and had shareholders approval to issue additional share issues for further acquisitions.

Two of the group's major divisions Plumbware and Aluminium Profiles are involved in supplying the building sector while the Engineering sector and the smaller Plastics division were not significantly involved in that sector.
It said the difficult trading circumstances would continue in the short term.
It reported attributable earnings down to 2.65 cents from 17.57 cents previously. Pre-tax income was at 3.74 million rand from 8.66 million rand before.
